text:
Every negative thought you ignore becomes permanent.

Your subconscious doesn't sleep. When you go quiet, it fills the space. If you don't feed it what you want, it feeds itself fear.

Here's what happens:

1. You stop talking back to doubt.
2. Doubt becomes the voice in your head.
3. That voice becomes your life.

The break:

1. Write your goal in plain words.
2. Read it first thing and at night.
3. Your mind becomes what you feed it.

Your subconscious will destroy you if you let it. Feed it instead. Today.
caption:
Build your subconscious through discipline. Stop leaving your mind on autopilot.
Send this to a man who needs it today.
